sub_graphs.title: Prague: RIPEMD-160 Precompile Invocation
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of a call to the RIPEMD-160 hash precompiled contract

nodes.label: RIPEMD-160 Precompile Called
nodes.description: EVM has routed execution to the RIPEMD-160 precompile address (0x03)

nodes.label: Gas Charged
nodes.description: Gas for RIPEMD-160 operation has been successfully deducted

nodes.label: Hash Computed
nodes.description: RIPEMD-160 hash of input data has been calculated

nodes.label: Output Padded
nodes.description: 20-byte hash has been left-padded to 32 bytes

nodes.label: RIPEMD-160 Complete
nodes.description: Precompile execution finished successfully

nodes.label: Receive Hash Input
nodes.description: Access input data from evm.message.data

nodes.label: Charge RIPEMD Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_RIPEMD160 + GAS_RIPEMD160_WORD * word_count

nodes.label: Compute RIPEMD-160 Hash
nodes.description: Execute hashlib.new('ripemd160', data).digest()

nodes.label: Pad Output to 32 Bytes
nodes.description: Left-pad 20-byte hash with 12 zero bytes to create 32-byte output

nodes.label: Set EVM Output
nodes.description: Assign padded hash to evm.output

edges.label: Contract calls RIPEMD-160 precompile at address 0x03

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract or EOA invoking the RIPEMD-160 precompile

sub_graphs.title: Prague: RIPEMD-160 Precompile Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for the RIPEMD-160 precompile

nodes.label: Gas Available
nodes.description: Gas available before RIPEMD-160 precompile execution

nodes.label: Sufficient Gas
nodes.description: Enough gas available for the hash operation

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: Not enough gas, operation will fail

nodes.label: Get Input Length
nodes.description: Determine length of input data in bytes

nodes.label: Round to 32-Byte Boundary
nodes.description: Apply ceil32() to round up to nearest 32-byte word

nodes.label: Compute Word Count
nodes.description: Divide rounded length by 32 to get word count

nodes.label: Compute Total Gas
nodes.description: Calculate GAS_RIPEMD160 + (GAS_RIPEMD160_WORD * word_count)

nodes.label: Deduct Gas
nodes.description: Subtract computed gas from available gas

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state what happens when input data length is zero.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume zero-length input is valid and produces the RIPEMD-160 hash of empty input, padded to 32 bytes.

ambiguities.text: The specific values of GAS_RIPEMD160 and GAS_RIPEMD160_WORD constants are not defined in this file.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these are standard constants defined elsewhere (historically GAS_RIPEMD160=600, GAS_RIPEMD160_WORD=120).

ambiguities.text: The term 'left-aligned zero padding' could mean left-padding (zeros before hash) or left-aligning (hash at start, zeros after).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'left-aligned zero padding' means the 20-byte hash is at the end of the 32-byte output, with 12 leading zero bytes (standard EVM convention for address-sized values).

implicit_assumptions.description: The hashlib.new('ripemd160') implementation is cryptographically correct and produces standards-compliant output.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect hash outputs could break contract logic relying on deterministic hashing.

implicit_assumptions.description: Finding collisions in RIPEMD-160 is computationally infeasible for practical attack scenarios.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash collision attacks could allow address spoofing or other cryptographic attacks against contracts using RIPEMD-160.

implicit_assumptions.description: The RIPEMD-160 algorithm is available in the Python hashlib module on all execution environments.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing hash algorithm could cause execution failures on some systems.

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas costs accurately reflect computational complexity and prevent DoS through large inputs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced hash operations could enable denial-of-service attacks.
